cases.title: Vote for Candidate A when unvoted
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'vote-button-A' when 'hasVoted' is absent increments Candidate A votes, updates 'total-votes', stores 'hasVoted' in localStorage, and shows a confirmation message that fades out after 3 seconds.

cases.title: Duplicate vote attempt for Candidate A
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'vote-button-A' when 'hasVoted' is set to 'true' in localStorage triggers an alert with message 'You've already voted!' and does not modify vote counts.

cases.title: Vote for Candidate B with chart and confirmation updates
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'vote-button-B' when unvoted increments Candidate B count, updates 'total-votes', updates 'results-chart', and displays a temporary confirmation element with class 'confirmation' that fades out after 3 seconds.

cases.title: Duplicate vote attempt for Candidate B
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'vote-button-B' when the user has already voted triggers an alert with 'You've already voted!' and leaves vote counts unchanged.

cases.title: Vote for Candidate C with localStorage tracking
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'vote-button-C' when unvoted increments Candidate C count, updates 'total-votes', displays confirmation message with class 'confirmation', and tracks status via 'hasVoted' in localStorage.

cases.title: Duplicate vote attempt for Candidate C
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'vote-button-C' when already voted prevents additional votes by displaying an alert and keeping total votes unchanged.

cases.title: Dynamic bar chart update and reset functionality
cases.description: Verify that casting any valid vote dynamically updates the bar chart 'results-chart' and that clicking 'reset-button' clears all votes, removes the 'hasVoted' flag, and resets chart and counts to zero.

cases.title: Real-time Total Votes counter and reset behavior
cases.description: Verify that the 'Total Votes' element ('total-votes') increments by 1 for any candidate vote, updates dynamically without refresh, and resets to '0' when the 'reset-button' is clicked.

cases.title: Detailed vote breakdown and percentage display
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'show-results-button' reveals 'detailed-results' showing accurate counts and percentages for each candidate based on 'total-votes', defaulting to '0' and '0%' if no votes are cast.

cases.title: Reset action effects on vote counts and detailed results
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'reset-button' resets all votes to zero, removes 'hasVoted', hides 'detailed-results', and displays an alert confirming the reset, allowing subsequent checks to show zero counts.

cases.title: Initial visibility and toggle behavior of detailed results
cases.description: Verify that 'detailed-results' is initially hidden on page load, becomes visible upon clicking 'show-results-button' (maintaining consistency on multiple clicks), and is hidden again when 'reset-button' is clicked with a reset alert.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all specified requirements comprehensively, and present no blockers.
All requirements and cases are well-defined, aligned, and testable.

analysis.analysis:
Testable behaviors, boundaries, normal/abnormal paths, and ambiguities by requirement ID:

- e2edev_bench_22-R-1:
  - Normal path: Click 'vote-button-A' when 'hasVoted' is absent in localStorage. Increments Candidate A vote count, updates 'total-votes', stores 'hasVoted' as true, appends confirmation message 'Thank you for voting for Candidate A!', which fades out after 3 seconds and is removed.
  - Abnormal path: Click 'vote-button-A' when 'hasVoted' is 'true'. Triggers alert 'You've already voted!' and makes no changes to vote counts or total votes.
  - Boundaries/Ambiguities: Exact string matching for confirmation and alert messages; timing window of 3 seconds for DOM removal.

- e2edev_bench_22-R-2:
  - Normal path: Click 'vote-button-B' with no prior vote. Increments Candidate B count, updates 'total-votes', updates 'results-chart', shows confirmation 'Thank you for voting for Candidate B!' with class 'confirmation' that fades out after 3 seconds, keeps detailed results hidden unless previously shown.
  - Abnormal path: Click 'vote-button-B' when already voted. Triggers alert 'You've already voted!', counts remain unchanged.
  - Boundaries/Ambiguities: Class name 'confirmation' must be applied to the temporary DOM element.

- e2edev_bench_22-R-3:
  - Normal path: Click 'vote-button-C' when unvoted. Increments Candidate C count, updates 'total-votes', displays confirmation 'Thank you for voting for Candidate C!' with class 'confirmation' fading out in 3 seconds.
  - Abnormal path: Click 'vote-button-C' when 'hasVoted' exists. Triggers alert 'You've already voted!', total votes unchanged.
  - Boundaries/Ambiguities: Uses 'hasVoted' key in localStorage consistently across candidates.

- e2edev_bench_22-R-5:
  - Normal path: Clicking any valid vote button ('vote-button-A', 'vote-button-B', 'vote-button-C') dynamically updates the bar chart ('results-chart'), increments totals, saves 'hasVoted' flag, and shows a fading confirmation message.
  - Abnormal path: Repeated voting attempt triggers an alert.
  - Reset functionality: Clicking 'reset-button' clears all votes, removes 'hasVoted' from localStorage, resets chart and vote counts to zero.

- e2edev_bench_22-R-6:
  - Normal path: Total votes ('total-votes') increments by 1 on any valid vote across candidates A, B, or C. 'Reset' button ('reset-button') sets total votes to '0'.
  - Abnormal path: Duplicate voting blocked by 'hasVoted' localStorage check accompanied by alert.
  - Boundaries/Ambiguities: Real-time DOM updates required without page refresh.

- e2edev_bench_22-R-7:
  - Normal path: Clicking 'show-results-button' makes 'detailed-results' visible, showing exact counts and percentages in 'votes-A/B/C' and 'percent-A/B/C' based on 'total-votes'.
  - Edge case: If no votes cast, counts and percentages display '0' and '0%'.

- e2edev_bench_22-R-9:
  - Normal path: Clicking 'reset-button' resets all counts to zero, removes 'hasVoted' flag, hides 'detailed-results', and shows an alert confirming reset (regardless of prior vote state).
  - Post-condition: Subsequent click on 'show-results-button' reveals 'detailed-results' showing zero counts and percentages, with 'total-votes' displaying '0'.

- e2edev_bench_22-R-11:
  - Normal path: 'detailed-results' is hidden by default on initial page load. Becomes visible only when 'show-results-button' is clicked (idempotent for multiple clicks).
  - Reset behavior: Clicking 'reset-button' hides the detailed results section and triggers an alert message confirming reset.
